subject: Coordinating demo + security onramp — next steps and available slots
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@helioshealth.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed next steps

Hi Julia / Tom —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re all aligned and to make scheduling the next session easier: 

- Primary objective: validate Redwood for deployment around patient-facing summarization workflows and prove SLA/cost targets under your 95th percentile latency requirement.
- Key stakeholders: Julia (product/clinical), Tom (procurement), security review (internal), platform/ops for SSO and network config.
- Open items: procurement paperwork, SSO requirements, SOC2 evidence, and a short ops checklist for our demo environment.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive / demo with security and platform present — we’ll cover architecture, SSO, privacy controls, and run a short live walkthrough.
2) Loop in Redwood security to exchange SOC2 and retention/evidence details.
3) Procurement: confirm path and required contractual attachments (NDA/PO, standard T&Cs).

To make scheduling painless — proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue 4/6, 10:00–11:00
- Wed 4/7, 13:00–14:00
- Fri 4/9, 11:00–12:00

If none of those work, tell me two windows that do and I’ll coordinate. I’ll also loop in our security lead and platform engineer once we lock a time so we’re fully prepared.

I’ve attached a short demo agenda and will attach our SOC2 snapshot once I confirm the right template to share.

Thanks —
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: demo_agenda_v1.docx
From: Julia Park <julia.park@helioshealth.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@helioshealth.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed next steps

Thanks Lukas — appreciate the summary.

We can do Fri 4/9 11:00–12:00 PT; that slot looks clean for the team. I’m looping in Tom (procurement) here — Tom, any constraints on contracting timeline or PO requirements we should flag before the demo?

Two quick asks for the deep dive:
- Can you bring someone from security who can speak to data residency and SOC2 artifacts?
- A short ops checklist for SSO and network (we’ll need to share IP ranges and cert info).

If you can send the SOC2 snapshot and proposed demo agenda ahead of time that’ll help Tom and our infra folks triage.

Best,
Julia Park
Director of Product, Helios Health
julia.park@helioshealth.com

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@helioshealth.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed next steps — confirming 4/9 + security docs

Perfect — locking Fri 4/9, 11:00–12:00 PT on our side and sending a calendar invite now.

Mina — looping you in to lead the security portion. Tom / Julia — Mina will cover SOC2 scope, data handling, and the minimal evidence we can share ahead of time (redacted). Karthik will join for platform/SSO/network questions.

I attached a SOC2 snapshot (redacted) and the demo agenda we discussed. Please treat the SOC2 PDF as internal/prospect-only — we’ll deliver a signed NDA if you prefer.

Action items: 
- Marina / Helios: Send over any SSO metadata (IdP details) and IP ranges or egress constraints prior to the demo.
- Tom: if there’s a standard procurement packet or PO template, share and we’ll have legal look for initial redlines.
- Mina / Karthik / Lukas: prep a 15-min security/ops block and 35-min demo + 10-min Q&A.

Thanks all — invite attached; agenda + SOC2 attached as well.

Cheers,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_SOC2-snapshot.pdf, demo_agenda_v1.docx
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@helioshealth.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Julia Park <julia.park@helioshealth.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed next steps — confirming 4/9 + security docs

Thanks Lukas — slot works for us.

Quick procurement note: Helios requires a supplier W-9 and our standard vendor onboarding form completed before we can process POs. I’ve attached the vendor form link below. Also, our legal team generally reviews any vendor T&Cs (we prefer redlines to your standard agreement) — would you be able to have legal send a starter redline or let me know the expected SLAs/cancellation terms?

Link to vendor onboarding form: https://vendor.helioshealth.com/onboarding/step1?ref=HL-2391
DocuSign for NDA (if needed): https://www.docusign.net/helloworld/abc123

Tom Ellis
Senior Procurement Manager, Helios Health
tom.ellis@helioshealth.com
